CORRECTION_1_RETRY_FAILED_SEMANTICS.description: Implemented dispatchRetryFailed() / getRetryableFailedIdentities() without mutating suppression state or generation. Normal failures are retryable and not suppressed.

CORRECTION_2_ADDITIVE_TEMPLATE_METADATA.description: templateId and templateVersion are strictly additive. No schema version bump. Tolerates missing fields. Not part of suppression identity.

CORRECTION_3_PRODUCTION_CONTROLLER_TESTI.description: Phase 2B acceptance tests directly invoke actual exported controller functions from popup.js (handleCreateNewTemplate, handleSaveTemplate, handleDuplicateTemplate, handleDeleteTemplate, handleSetDefaultTemplate, populateFormFromTemplate, filterHistoryRecords, dispatchSelectiveReset, dispatchRetryFailed, dispatchGlobalReset, triggerCsvExport, bindCampaignTemplateMetadata).

CORRECTION_4_NO_BACKGROUND_REWRITE.description: Background engine orchestration, crawler, suppression state machine, and migration protocol remain intact. Only additive templateId/templateVersion metadata was passed to recordAttempt.
